notes.title: KICKSTARTER ANNOUNCEMENT!!!
notes.content:
[h3]THIS IS GOING TO BE EPIC!!!
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44326669/906aba3fb6aca4f0b9443ed00984669447d736ea.jpg[/img]

We have finally took the step to create a [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/myfatherlied/my-father-lied]Kickstarter [/url]campaign. After seeing the love we got from many events Like Pax Australia and Gamescom Asia, to name a few, we wanted to make sure the game will look better before the release. The campaign is aimed to secure funds for more voice actors, more art, and for localization into many languages, so that we can include as many people from around the world and have them experience the story from where the first stories were written. 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44326669/4a1a706f24e0ddcf5ece2b5d68d05572b34bfd4c.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44326669/554c31cb136dbd6cd76ca04faf067665564675aa.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44326669/4ff8efb80cac7fe26b638b545fa6e389532da62f.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44326669/5247760370dfd5ce531eee46920c4a1569d1c447.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44326669/ced52afc18eca2a1234da7a0b957b301609f9045.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44326669/ea893a653432354285a11f64e767174102deda72.jpg[/img][/url]
[h3]Our Game at many gaming events[/h3] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44326669/ef9e60663ce37f9a15afa0bba9ea4034bdd413c3.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44326669/629f020998d0d67aa5b3e9564063fe66dc5ce392.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44326669/77430bcce0e240261038ed25a4204fcb8a5bbfca.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44326669/dd80575b08e444bb90b35f75f0e5b95393704959.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44326669/ced50a1dede430b0520de11e17badb015db78f0e.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44326669/c8e4993de2764f9297ff8de0b35339966b6948a2.jpg[/img][/url]

We are planning some amazing rewards for backing the game, things you will wish to have on your desk... or your resume, like the Royal game or Ur (The oldest board game in history), some Mesopotamian artifacts, the art book for the game, bringing YOU in the game, and my personal favorite, the emotional story puzzle book, My Father Promised, which is like a DLC in a book. There will be an early bird... Valentine discount for early backers who wish to get the game before anyone else.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44326669/e9168f14f6ee1601c754b32af1a1ddbba749a599.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44326669/4aef51795e87cbf029be41066c9b5ab8878faaf4.png[/img]

Also, we have amazing Stretch goals. Getting the last stretch will secure funds to create an actual DLC for the game. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44326669/b7ba873668147763ae1876605da26a7f319d98ac.jpg[/img]

You can follow the Kickstarter page [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/myfatherlied/my-father-lied]here [/url]to stay notified. 

Thank you in advance for your support. Your help will make My game become a reality. 

Be sure to follow me on my socials [url=https://linktr.ee/lunargames.uruk?utm_source=linktree_profile_share&ltsid=d32a4e21-06c4-412e-b329-3de765d8af38]here[/url].
